name: Chat with your event schedule from Google Sheets in Telegram
description: Connects a Google Sheet containing an event schedule to Telegram, allowing users to query their schedule through a Telegram bot.

source.path: Google_Drive_and_Google_Sheets/Chat with your event schedule from Google Sheets in Telegram.json

setup: "n8nInput" (chatTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
"telegramInput" (telegramTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Setup value spreadsheetId: Google Sheets spreadsheet id (for example 1AbC...xyz). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Provide run inputs: event, chatInput, sessionId, llm_system_7a14abbb5f, message.

hints: The original started from telegramTrigger; Yantra has no webhook slug for it, so run on demand, on a schedule (add a NodeCron), or via the workflow API with the event under the run input `event`.
Provide `chatInput` (and optionally `sessionId`) as run inputs; the original started from a chat message.
"ScheduleBot" kept conversation memory (memoryBufferWindow); sessionId is set to the run-input sessionId.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect telegram: `cdecli credential create -n "telegram" -p telegram --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
